facts: 50 is the neutral C20H30O3 ketoester defined by its mapped molecular graph. The treatment forms its tetrasubstituted O-TMS enol ether using HMDS (2.0 equiv) and TMSI (1.4 equiv) in CH2Cl2, 23 °C for 30 min, then performs protonolysis in a second pot with racemic camphorsulfonic acid (1.0 equiv), 23 °C for 30 min. Two conflicting THF/MeOH volume ratios are recorded: 1:1 and 6.0/0.60 mL (10:1); neither is uniquely established. After each pass, cis material is separated and trans material is returned to the sequence. Connectivity and pre-existing stereochemistry are supplied.
scope: Local stereochemistry of ketoester 50 and the tetrasubstituted O-trimethylsilyl enol ether used in its protonolysis. The remaining polycyclic skeleton and stereocentres are fixed. Full diterpenoid synthesis, acid screening and exact isolated-yield simulation are excluded.
